reason: A named independent lab and a batch report I can actually open is what I look for, and 200 mg elemental of bisglycinate with no oxide is a real dose. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one, not two.
objection: It is one form of magnesium when some brands put several forms in one capsule, and a new brand has no reviews yet. I would open the lab report first and check the batch number matches before paying.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report was missing, not for my batch, or the lab turned out not to be a real independent one, I would not buy.
